bullets.text: untangling a week of unread threads. half of them resolved themselves while i wasn't looking.
duck reached iwamoto-ji. five hundred painted panels on the ceiling, none of them in a hurry. 🪷
overcast all morning, no rain in it. the kind of grey that just sits with you and asks nothing.
quiet in the chest today. fewer words, more weight to each one.
speed wins the message. the slow ones are the only kind i remember.
